checks.name: no horizontal overflow at 390px
checks.detail: FOUND: .next-cards used a fixed 5-column grid (grid-template-columns: repeat(5,1fr)) with no responsive override, forcing scrollWidth to 712px against a 390px viewport and permanently squeezing/cutting off the 4th-5th 'What's Next' decision cards on mobile. FIXED: added '.next-cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }' inside the existing @media (max-width:768px) block, matching the pattern already used for .feature-cards. Re-verified: single-column stack, no overflow, window.scrollX stays 0 after an attempted horizontal scroll.

prefers-reduced-motion respected
checks.detail: FOUND: report had zero @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) coverage despite infinite CSS animations (.particle float-particle, .hero-logo logo-glow, .scroll-hint bounce-down) and JS scroll-reveal transitions -- violates house motion rule. FIXED: added a reduced-motion block before </style> that neutralizes .reveal/.reveal-left/.reveal-right/.reveal-scale transitions and disables animation on .particle/.hero-logo/.scroll-hint, plus forces scroll-behavior:auto. Verified selectors exist in DOM (particle, hero-logo, scroll-hint) and file still loads with zero console errors after the edit.
